warning.exec_migration: The migration '%migrationName%' has already been executed.

info.create_migration: Remember to add the necessary fields to the migration before running it with `php rabbit migrate`
info.help:
Available commands:
	make controller {name}
		Creates a controller
	make validator {name}
		Creates a validator
	make model {name} [--no-migration]
		Creates a model with its associated migration (with --no-migration the migration is not created)
	make migration {name}
		Creates a migration
	serve
		Starts a local test server
	help
		Displays this list of commands
	i18n addLang {xx_XX} [--copyFrom[{xx_XX}]]
		Adds a new language to the system (optionally copying the structure from another)
	i18n addSection {section_name}
		Adds a new section to all languages

error.clear: Could not clear the log file
